title: Prime Checker
description: Check whether an integer is prime and list its prime factors with exponents. Trial division runs locally. Nothing is uploaded.
intro: Enter a positive integer to see if it is prime, plus the full prime factorization when it is composite. Handy for homework and quick checks.
blurb: Test primality and show prime factors entirely in the browser.
howItWorks: Enter a positive integer up to 15 digits.
Press Check. The page trial-divides by primes up to the square root.
Read whether it is prime and the exponent form of its factors.
examples: 17 is prime, so the factorization is 17.
1 is neither prime nor composite and is reported that way.

faq.a: Inputs longer than 15 digits are rejected so the page stays responsive. Use a computer-algebra tool for huge integers.
